conditional_corollary: After any exact identification of normalization(H) with E1, the standard unramified 2-isogeny Kummer class is not a constant times any nontrivial product of the three cuboid characters modulo squares.
logical_scope: The ramification theorem is unconditional and does not assume C025. The comparison with E1 is conditional on C025 and rules out only a direct function-field square-class identity; it does not classify rational points.
theorem: Every nontrivial product of q+2, q-2 and epsilon*V is ramified on the normalization of H, for epsilon=+1 or -1.
